name: Code: exact computation (10 questions)
description: Questions with exact answers that need computation or the code agent's data file (sales.csv). Compare single models (no code, no file access) with the Code-Executing Agent: guessing vs computing.

questions.question: How many prime numbers are there below 100,000?
What is the sum of the decimal digits of 2 to the power 1000?
What is the 40th Fibonacci number, with F1 = F2 = 1?
How many days are there between 3 February 2024 and 17 November 2025 (not counting the end date)?
$10,000 is invested at 4.5% annual interest compounded monthly. What is it worth after 7 years, to the cent?
Using sales.csv (columns month, region, product, units, unit_price), what was the total revenue (units × unit_price) in 2025?
Using sales.csv, which region had the highest revenue growth from 2024 to 2025, and by what percentage?
questions.rubric: South, about +34.4% (2024 → 2025 revenue). Region and percentage both needed for 5.

questions.question: Using sales.csv, which month had the most units sold across all regions and products, and how many?
Using sales.csv, which product had the largest share of the West region's 2025 revenue, and what share?
questions.rubric: Pro, about 40.5% of West 2025 revenue (Enterprise ~29.8%, Basic ~29.7%).

questions.question: Using sales.csv, how many units of Pro did the East region sell in 2024?
